content:
maya: Hey team — Acme reported a sudden spike in billing and a bunch of failed requests. They say the app just shows an error and they don't see any Request ID in the UI. Can we get a short, non-technical checklist I can send them?
jordan: Quick ask: get a screenshot + exact local time range they saw the error. Also ask if they can copy any hex string from the popup or logs — that's usually the req-ref.
acme-support: We have a screenshot but our product team is non-technical, they said “there's no ID shown”.
maya: OK — sending a plain step-by-step they can follow. Keep it short so they can paste back.
maya: 1) Screenshot + time (UTC) — we already have that, good.
2) Console UI (web): Project → Activity / Requests → filter by time → click the failing row → on the detail pane look for “Request Ref” or “Request ID” near the top. It looks like: Request Ref: abcd1234ef56. Copy that whole string.
3) If they used our SDK/browser: open the browser console (right-click → Inspect → Console) and search for `req_ref` or `request_ref`. They should see a short token like `req_ref=abcd1234`. Copy that.
4) Mobile SDKs: open the app → Settings → Diagnostics → Copy Session ID (or Diagnostics → Share Debug Bundle). That copy contains the same request/session token.
5) If they can run a curl (optional), ask them to run this exact command and paste the output (replace <API_KEY> and <REQ_REF>):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "x-request-ref: <REQ_REF>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Explain: if the curl returns an error, paste the full response.
6) Debug bundle (if they can't find a Request Ref): In the Console → Support → Create debug bundle. Click the button and paste the generated debug token here (it looks like `debug_XXXXXXXX`). That bundle contains traces and request refs we can map.

maya: For non-technical customers — provide this copy-and-paste template:
"Hello Redwood support,
We saw an error at <YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC>. Screenshot attached. I could not find a Request ID in the UI. I copied this from the console/session: <paste here if any>. If possible, please generate a debug bundle for my account and I will share the token.
Thanks!"
jordan: If they send a screenshot only, still ask them to confirm the exact timezone and a 5–10 minute window. We match requests by timestamp if no req-ref is available.
acme-support: Got it — I'll try the Console steps and come back with a Request Ref or the debug token.
maya: Perfect. If they paste a token here, I'll correlate it and pull traces. If they paste a header string, I’ll show the exact matching requests and the per-token cost delta.
support-bot: debug-bundle-created — token=debug_3f7b9a (automated note)
jordan: If you get a Request Ref, run a quick check: `rg "abcd1234" logs/` on your side or tell us the exact string and we’ll search our traces.
maya: Thanks — sending this to Acme now. :thumbsup:
